ratios.quote: The covenants under the Credit Agreement and Term Loan include, among other things, a financial maintenance covenant that requires us to comply with a maximum total net leverage ratio. We were in compliance with the financial maintenance covenant under our Credit Agreement and Term Loan as of September 30, 2026.

parsed.notes: The filing says the Credit Agreement and Term Loan carry a maximum total net leverage ratio covenant and that the company was in compliance at 2026-09-30, but it gives neither the actual ratio nor the limit. The total net leverage ratio is also used to set the SOFR margin and commitment fee; those pricing references are excluded.
